name: ANUBIS
summary: ANUBIS is proposed for the CERN ATLAS cavern; the current design covers its ceiling. It uses an existing underground LHC cavern to search for long-lived particles. Its historical In-Shaft name is retained although the layout has changed.
detection_principle: Large-area RPCs detect particles escaping ATLAS and decaying in its cavern. Tracks and timing reconstruct displaced vertices, correlated with ATLAS information.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
